question: Do positive Frobenius-fixed loci exhaust each frozen finite extension point group exactly as required by the 119-theorem algebraic-point bridge, and what point-period strata are omitted by checking only the base locus or only proper periods?

field_construction.representation: GF(p)[u] modulo the lexicographically first monic irreducible polynomial of the frozen degree

producer.source_hash: to be sealed by FROBENIUS_FIXED_LOCI_SOURCE_GATE.md before execution

independent_verifier.method: separate Python polynomial-basis field and affine group implementation; reconstruct every point and Frobenius orbit from the frozen cell definitions
independent_verifier.source_hash: to be sealed by FROBENIUS_FIXED_LOCI_SOURCE_GATE.md before execution

positive_checks: every enumerated point has a least positive Frobenius period r with 1<=r<=degree
every least period r divides the frozen extension degree
the period histogram sums to the complete enumerated point group
for each n from 1 through degree, the measured pi^n fixed count equals the sum of least-period strata whose period divides n
the degree-th fixed locus equals the complete point group
the first fixed locus equals the independently recomputed base-field point count
the characteristic expression pi^2-[t]pi+[p] has zero failures in every least-period stratum
controls: the period-one locus is a proper subset of every degree-greater-than-one extension group
the union of all proper-period strata is a proper subset of every extension group
the full-degree least-period stratum is nonempty in every cell
wrong trace t+1 rejects at least one enumerated point
wrong norm p+1 rejects at least one enumerated point
measurements: least-period histogram for r=1 through degree
pi^n fixed counts for n=1 through degree
period-one, proper-period-union, full-period, and total point counts
characteristic failures and coefficient-mutation rejections by least-period stratum
producer and independent-verifier elapsed nanoseconds as single-run diagnostics

acceptance.primary: all positive checks pass in all eight cells
acceptance.controls: every frozen control rejects in every cell
acceptance.failure_policy: retain every row and every empty or unexpected stratum; do not replace a curve, degree, modulus rule, check, or control

claim_boundary: A finite orbit-stratification test of the proved exhaustion interface. It does not prove the characteristic equation on arbitrary finite fixed loci, identify rational or scheme morphisms, solve ECDLP, or establish a runtime improvement.
